notes.title: Idle Warrior out NOW! 🔥
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1241020/Idle_Warrior/

[h1]Hey everyone! 🥰

I am happy to announce that my game "Idle Warrior" just released! 

It's a cool and addictive idle/clicker game with a nice and simple setting.

You are a warrior who has to increase his various stats like damage, speed and critical hit chances to fight an infinite army of stronger getting enemies. The player can also purchase pets which have a bunch of different talents to support you. 

Pick a passive idle playstyle or level up your clicker level to spam with clicks yourself and get stronger from every fight! 🔥

The game supports various playstyles, infinitely harder getting enemies & +100 Steam achievements! It will also have a DLC available during the release and more updates and DLC's are planned for the future!

For those people who never played an idle game before, we also prepared a small tutorial ːHeartyouː

Check it out NOW! 🔥

The game is currently available at a 40% launch discount during the first week which means that you can get it for as cheap as $1.19!

Also feel free to share your feedback with me as always![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1241020/Idle_Warrior/

notes.title: New game: Particle Wars out NOW!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

[h1]I recently released a new game called Particle Wars!

It's a cool arcade space shooter with appealing visuals, 6 different levels and an infinite game mode.  [/h1]
 
You have to shoot hostile particles with a variety different weapons and last as long as you can with the help of randomly dropping power ups, healing items and your survival skills!

The game also features Steam achievements, some cool soundtracks and full controller support!

[h1]It released on the 1st October and is currently available at a 40% discount for $0.59! [/h1]

Check it out here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160700/Particle_Wars/


Thanks for reading this! Your feedback would be appreciated and I wish you a great day!

notes.title: Update News: Jump Delay Fix
notes.content:
Hey!


We just launched an update with adjustments to the jumping mechanic, because many of you criticized that the delay of falling back to the ground was too long. We changed the delay from 1.75s to only 1.25s, which should make the game feel much more responsive.

If you have further wishes or critique, please let us know!
